in_sanskrit.name: Samrath
in_sanskrit.meaning: one who rules, reigns supreme, conquers, and subjugates

in_marathi.name: Samrath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruling, Governance, King
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samrath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has the power to rule and govern, a king, a leader, a ruler
